error.mic-denied: Munder Difflin may not use the microphone. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone on a Mac, or Settings → Privacy → Microphone on Windows.
error.mic-unavailable: The microphone could not be opened. Check that one is connected and not held by another app.
error.host-failed: The recorder did not start. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart Munder Difflin.
error.capture-failed: The recording could not be saved.
error.capture-timeout: The recorder stopped answering, so the dictation was dropped.
error.transcribe-timeout: Transcription took too long and was stopped.
error.insert-failed: The words could not be typed.

notice.user-choice: You chose to paste them yourself.
notice.accessibility: To have them typed for you, allow Munder Difflin in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
notice.automation: To have them typed for you, allow Munder Difflin to control System Events in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation.
notice.wayland: Wayland doesn't let one app type into another. With wtype installed (Sway, Hyprland and other wlroots desktops) it can; otherwise press Ctrl+V yourself.
notice.wtype-failed: This desktop refused wtype (GNOME and KDE don't offer the virtual keyboard it needs). Press Ctrl+V yourself.
notice.no-xdotool: Install xdotool to have them typed for you, for example: sudo apt install xdotool
notice.no-display: No X11 or Wayland display was found to type into.
notice.no-powershell: Windows PowerShell wasn't found, so the paste key could not be pressed.
notice.paste-failed: Pressing the paste key didn't work. Paste them yourself.
notice.focus-ours: Munder Difflin had come to the front, so they were not pasted into the other app.
notice.no-field: No text box had focus in Munder Difflin.
notice.unsupported-platform: Typing into other apps isn't supported on this system.

strategy.in-app: Your words go straight into the focused text box.
strategy.osascript: In other apps your words are pasted for you with ⌘V.
strategy.sendkeys: In other apps your words are pasted for you with Ctrl+V.
strategy.xdotool: In other apps your words are pasted for you with Ctrl+V, through xdotool.
strategy.wtype: In other apps your words are pasted for you with Ctrl+V, through wtype.
strategy.clipboard: In other apps your words are copied to the clipboard for you to paste.

result.clipboard: Last dictation, left on the clipboard:

accelError.syntax: That isn't a shortcut Munder Difflin can use.
accelError.no-key: Add a key to the modifiers.
accelError.needs-modifier: Hold at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Option or Command with it; on its own the key could no longer be typed.
accelError.reserved: The system, or every app, already uses that one.
accelError.conflict: That one belongs to the other dictation key or to the Stapler's meeting shortcut.
accelError.invalid: That setting could not be saved.

settings.title: Dictate into any app
settings.intro: Press {{shortcut}}, talk, and press it again. The words land in the text box in front of you, in any app and in every text box inside Munder Difflin.
settings.holdNote: A global shortcut can't tell when a key is let go, so the shortcut starts and stops. On Windows and Linux (X11) you can also hold it while you talk: when the key stops repeating, dictation stops and types. {{cancel}} throws a dictation away.
settings.holdNoteMac: macOS can't give an app the bare Option key as a shortcut, and a shortcut can't tell when it is let go, so press once to start and again to stop. {{cancel}} throws a dictation away.
settings.shortcutFocusedOnly: Only while Munder Difflin has focus
settings.cancelNote: The cancel key is only held while you dictate, so it never takes the key away from other apps the rest of the time.
settings.takenHelp: Another app holds this shortcut. Pick a different one, or free it in that app.
settings.waylandShortcut: On Wayland, apps only receive keys while they have focus, so the shortcut works inside Munder Difflin only. Elsewhere, use Dictate on the Stapler's ring.
settings.restoreNote: Your words travel through the clipboard. Afterwards the text, links, rich text or image you had copied come back; copied files do not.
settings.inAppNote: Inside Munder Difflin no paste key is pressed: the words go straight into the text box at the cursor.
settings.safetyNote: A dictation you forget about ends by itself and is typed like any other.
settings.tryPlaceholder: Click here, press {{shortcut}} and say something.
settings.loadFailed: Dictation settings could not be loaded.

status.automationNote: The first paste asks to let Munder Difflin control System Events. Allow it, or the words stay on the clipboard.
status.waylandNote: Wayland doesn't let one app type into another. wtype can on Sway, Hyprland and other wlroots desktops; on GNOME and KDE your words are copied for you to paste.
status.xdotoolNote: Install xdotool to have your words typed for you, for example: sudo apt install xdotool
